_asserts: A null `spend.limit` beside real spend parses to credits with a nil limitMinor — the cap is off, the credits are not gone (CCM-44 / Android CCBG-9).

limitMinor, percent, percentDisplay and remainingMinor are absent from this file on purpose: absence asserts nil. Never synthesise 0% — a 0% bar reads as headroom against a ceiling that doesn't exist.
`isReportable` is true: real spend earns the row even with no cap. Render as spend + 'No cap', with no bar.
The exponent falls back to `used.exponent` when there is no limit block to carry one.
